repos_data.description: Open tax skills for AI: 2,250 skills across 266 jurisdictions, every figure cited to the law. Works in ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and any MCP client.
:tv: A free and simple to use video player made with Haskell.

ComplyEaze Bridge is an open-source (Apache-2.0) TallyPrime MCP server for Claude Desktop, for CA firms and accountants. Reads the books on your own computer; prepares vouchers from bank statements as an import file. Posting is off by default; when on, you approve each voucher.

Turns Indian GST tax invoices into government INV-01 JSON. Tells you exactly what it couldn't read, and never invents a value to fill a gap. MCP server with OCR, deterministic extraction, and a grounded LLM stage.
